I’m finishing up my video about the knowledge graph of machine learning [ https://substack.com/redirect/fe4d459d-e0c5-4309-8ec8-fe5acfaef8bd?j=eyJ1IjoiOG81NG4ifQ.6oeetudtJEh-zO1onUJvtadWEdbodFIw0h4xbugrh1o ], which will be released next week; I’ll do a live premiere right here on Substack Live, with a discussion after the viewing. (You can join here. [ https://open.substack.com/live-stream/160251 ])
This video will mark a milestone for me: instead of relying on hand-crafted slides and a presentation-style exposition, I built a scripting engine on top of the knowledge graph explorer that turns a JSON script like
[{
  "at": 0.0,
  "action": "autoRotate",
  "axis": "y",
  "speed": 0.01,
  "duration": 9.3,
  "windDown": 2.0,
  "easing": "linear"
},
{
  "at": 9.3,
  "action": "selectNode",
  "nodeId": "gpt",
  "showPrerequisites": true,
  "showDependents": false,
  "duration": 2.0
}]
into a beautifully rendered video.
